name: AMENDMENT_A1
reason: Engineering fix to the shared heavy-process semaphore (no scientific code): a signalled wrapper now forwards SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to its child, reaps it, logs the signal and releases the slot, so a killed wrapper can never orphan a heavy child (independent verifier PHASE_2A WARN: the math-review role's queued C:mutation wrapper acquired slot 1 at 05:11:46Z and was killed without a release record). Tested: SIGTERM -> child terminated, signal + release logged, slot free. The first version of this fix deadlocked (wait inside the handler); it was replaced before use and never ran a study process.
